dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Hi, Nam! Did you have a good weekend?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ, ˈnɑːm! dɪd juː ˈhæv ə ˈɡʊd ˈwiːkɛnd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I did. I met up with my cousin Kwan on Sunday.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈdɪd. aɪ ˈmɛt ˈʌp wɪð maɪ ˈkʌzən ˈkwɑːn ɑːn ˈsʌndeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: We went to a theme park. We had a lot of fun!
dialogue.reading: wiː ˈwɛnt tə ə ˈθiːm ˌpɑːrk. wiː ˈhæd ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈfʌn!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I did. But on Saturday night, I saw a musical with Fah.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈdɪd. bʌt ɑːn ˈsætərdeɪ ˈnaɪt, aɪ ˈsɔː ə ˈmjuːzɪkəl wɪð ˈfɑː.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: A musical? Did you like it?
dialogue.reading: ə ˈmjuːzɪkəl? dɪd juː ˈlaɪk ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, I didn't. It was too long!
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, aɪ ˈdɪdənt. ɪt wʌz ˈtuː ˈlɔːŋ!
